subject: Cannot get covariate in continuous format

messages.author: 985e455b8390aae3
messages.subject: Cannot get covariate in continuous format
parts:
Hi, all...

I've used read.csv to import a data file that has "minutes" (search
duration) as a continuous variable.

I used "data$min<-as.numeric(as.character(data$min))" to ensure the
dataframe recognized it as a numeric format, then used "formatLong" to
convert the dataframe to unmarkedFramePcount format.

However, "minutes" is still getting read into the unmarked frame as a
factor. I even tried "jittering" the data so there were several
decimal places on all of the values, but it still appears that
"formatLong" is converting "minutes" to a factor.

Thoughts?

Shane

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Cannot get covariate in continuous format

mod2 <- pcount(~as.numeric(min) ~vh1, data=counts, se=FALSE) #test model
